description: Work with Lead Gen & CRM (formerly SharpSpring): find, create, update and delete leads, manage list members, opportunities and accounts, and start workflows when leads, opportunities, accounts or list members are added or change.

sharpspring_lead_changed_trigger.description: Runs each time a lead changes, such as its status, score or details, and when one is created. Changes made before the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.lead: Every field of the lead, custom fields included, by system name.
output.lead_status: Its status: unqualified, open, qualified, contact or contactWithOpp.
output.owner_id: The ID of the user who owns it.
output.updated_at: When it last changed, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS (UTC).

parameters.description: Only leads this user owns. Leave blank for every lead.
parameters.name: owner_id

sharpspring_new_account_trigger.description: Runs for each new account (company). Accounts already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.account: Every field of the account, custom fields included.
output.owner_id: The ID of the user who owns it.

parameters.description: Only accounts this user owns. Leave blank for every account.
parameters.name: owner_id

sharpspring_new_lead_trigger.description: Runs for each new lead (contact), with its details. Leads already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.lead: Every field of the lead, custom fields included, by system name.
output.lead_status: Its status: unqualified, open, qualified, contact or contactWithOpp.
output.owner_id: The ID of the user who owns it.
output.updated_at: When it last changed, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS (UTC).

parameters.description: Only leads this user owns. Leave blank for every lead.
parameters.name: owner_id

sharpspring_new_list_member_trigger.description: Runs when a lead joins a list, with who they are. Members already on the list when the workflow is turned on don't start it. Watches the first 5,000 members of a list.

parameters.description: The list to watch.
parameters.name: list_id

sharpspring_new_opportunity_trigger.description: Runs for each new opportunity (deal), with its amount, stage and owner. Opportunities already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.account_id: The ID of its account, if any.
output.close_date: When it is expected to close, or closed.
output.deal_stage_id: The ID of its deal stage.
output.opportunity: Every field of the opportunity, custom fields included.
output.owner_id: The ID of the user who owns it.
output.primary_lead_id: The lead ID of its main contact, if any.
